We were able to blame yesterday’s lack of activity on a paucity of catalysts to spur activity on a late-summer Monday. The story is similar today, except that Tuesdays lack the sense of ennui that often accompanies Mondays. Put simply, there has been a lack of catalysts on a popular vacation week. Tomorrow’s CPI and Thursday’s PPI reports might wake things up – including the somnolent VIX.
